about.title: Professional legal service with a personal approach
about.p1: The office provides legal and notarial services with emphasis on precision, accessibility and clear communication at every step.
about.p2: Matters are handled with practical planning, accurate documentation, and close follow-up until completion.
about.p3:
Moria Rodrig, Advocate and Notary, is an experienced legal professional with extensive practice in real estate and civil-commercial law. Over the years, she has developed strong practical expertise in handling complex property transactions, while providing precise legal solutions tailored to each client’s needs.

Her office provides comprehensive legal support for real estate transactions from preliminary due diligence, through negotiation and contract drafting, and up to final registration with the Land Registry.

Moria has unique expertise in representing foreign residents and regularly advises clients from Israel and abroad in real estate matters, notarial documentation, and cross-border legal procedures, with multilingual service delivered efficiently and accurately, including remote handling where required.

In addition, her office handles wills, enduring powers of attorney, commercial agreements, and full notarial services in accordance with applicable regulations, with consistent emphasis on professionalism, availability, and personal guidance throughout the process.

Beyond her legal practice, Moria is active in public service and serves as Chair of the Association of Belgian Immigrants in Israel, and as a municipal representative in the Reservists’ Wives Forum, reflecting a deep commitment to community and social resilience.

Moria believes in combining legal precision, strategic thinking, and personal service, and accompanies her clients with confidence and transparency until the optimal result is achieved.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy concerns this website and enquiries to Moria Rodrig Law Office & Notary, the controller of the personal information. Online booking and the contact form are currently disabled.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This policy concerns this website and enquiries to Moria Rodrig Law Office & Notary, the controller of the personal information. Online booking and the contact form are currently disabled.

data.title: Information collected
data.body: Hosting and external services receive technical data such as IP address, browser details and requested pages. If you contact us by email or phone, we receive the contact details and information you provide. Clarity receives interaction and device data only after analytics consent.

purpose.title: Purposes
purpose.body: We use information to deliver and secure the website, respond to enquiries and provide requested legal services. Optional Clarity analytics helps us understand website usage and improve usability.

systems.title: Services and recipients
systems.body: The hosting provider serves the site. Mapbox supplies the embedded office maps and Google Fonts supplies typefaces; these requests expose technical data including IP address to those providers. Microsoft receives optional Clarity analytics. Online Google Calendar booking and the associated database workflow are not currently available to visitors.

cookies.title: Cookies and your choice
cookies.body: Optional analytics is off by default. Accept analytics or reject optional cookies in the notice; the details link opens this cookies section. You can withdraw or change your choice through Cookie settings in the footer. Continuing to browse is not consent. Rejection does not restrict browsing. Your versioned choice and its date are kept in local storage for 180 days; clearing browser storage removes it. If storage is blocked, your choice may not persist. When allowed, Clarity uses _clck (visitor/preferences) and _clsk (session association); Microsoft documents any third-party cookies. Advertising storage is denied. Withdrawal clears accessible Clarity cookies on this site and reloads the page to stop collection. Cookies on Microsoft domains can be managed through your browser.

legalBasis.title: Voluntary provision of information
legalBasis.body: Contacting the office and allowing analytics are voluntary; there is no legal obligation to do either. Without enough contact information, we may be unable to respond or provide the service you request. Without analytics consent, Clarity does not load. Maps and fonts still request data needed to display those services.

disclosure.title: Disclosure and international processing
disclosure.body: Information is received by the service providers described above for the stated purposes and may be processed outside Israel. Information may also be disclosed when required by law or necessary to handle your requested legal service. External links lead to services governed by their own privacy policies.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: The privacy preference expires after 180 days. Enquiry and client information is retained as needed to handle the request and meet applicable legal and professional recordkeeping duties. Hosting, mapping, font and analytics providers apply their own retention periods; see their policies linked below.

security.title: Security
security.body: Technical controls cannot eliminate all risk. Please do not send sensitive case details through ordinary email before agreeing with the office on an appropriate communication channel.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Subject to Israeli law, you may request access to personal information held about you under section 13 of the Protection of Privacy Law, and correction or deletion of information that is incorrect, incomplete, unclear or outdated under section 14. Contact the office below. You may withdraw analytics consent at any time through Cookie settings.

revisions.title: Changes
revisions.body: Updated 2 October 2026. Material changes to optional tracking require a new consent choice. This website notice does not replace the arrangements for a legal engagement.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: We work to make this website usable for people with disabilities. This statement describes the accessibility adjustments made and the current limitations.
features: Navigate links, buttons and the language selector with the keyboard. Use the skip link to go directly to the page content.
Keyboard focus is visible. Opening cookie controls moves focus to the notice; closing them returns focus to the control that opened them.
Pages use headings and landmarks. Service category buttons announce which category is selected, and images have alternative text.
The layout adapts to narrow screens and browser zoom. Hebrew uses right-to-left reading direction.
The site respects your device’s reduced-motion setting. Essential browsing works when optional analytics is rejected.
accessibility.limitations: The embedded Mapbox map and external publications are third-party content. We cannot guarantee their full accessibility. The office address and contact details are provided as text, with links to Google Maps and Waze as alternatives. A complete manual assessment with assistive technologies has not yet been completed.
accessibility.help: If you encounter a barrier, contact the office by phone or email. Please describe the page, the problem and the browser or assistive technology used, if possible. You can also request the information or service through these channels.
accessibility.office: For verified information about access to the physical office, parking, lifts or other accommodations, please contact the office before visiting.
accessibility.review: Updated 2 October 2026. Automated accessibility checks and keyboard, focus, contrast, mobile layout and zoom checks were performed. Our accessibility target is Israeli Standard 5568 at level AA. These checks do not establish complete conformity; further manual assistive-technology review is still needed.
